title: Medical Phenotyping of NHS General Adult Psychiatry (GAP) Inpatients
official: Medical Phenotyping of NHS General Adult Psychiatry (GAP) Inpatients
summary: This observational study will characterise the general psychiatric and general medical phenotypes of 100 adults, sequentially admitted to NHS General Adult Psychiatry (GAP) "mental health" inpatient wards, providing the first detailed information on morbidity in this patient population.

interventions.name: Questionnaires, rating scales, & review of notes

criteria:
Inclusion:

\- Adults aged between 18 and 65 years admitted to GAP wards during recruitment period

Exclusion:

\- Admissions to non-GAP wards (e.g., forensic psychiatry, young people's units, perinatal, old age psychiatry, or general medical wards)
